# NorthLane AI

> NorthLane AI is a Southern California marketing studio for small and local businesses. It does SEO, GEO (generative engine optimization) and AEO (answer engine optimization), builds fast websites, and sets up lead follow-up in GoHighLevel. Founded and run by Ethan.

- Service area: Inland Empire, Orange County, Los Angeles County, San Diego County; remote work anywhere in the US
- Audience: small, local and service businesses
- Contact: https://northlaneai.com/contact/
- Policy: no fake reviews and no made-up numbers; unfinished services are labeled as such

## Services
- [Google profile and reviews](https://northlaneai.com/services/google-profile-reviews/): A complete Google Business Profile and a steady stream of real reviews. It's what Maps, Google's AI and ChatGPT all lean on.
- [AI search visibility (SEO, GEO, AEO)](https://northlaneai.com/services/ai-search-visibility/): Show up when customers search Google, Google Maps, ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity for what you sell in your area.
- [Fast websites](https://northlaneai.com/services/websites/): Fast, simple sites with a page for every service and city, a call button on every screen, and every lead sent to one place you can see.
- [Lead follow-up and CRM](https://northlaneai.com/services/lead-follow-up/): Missed-call text back, fast replies and review requests in GoHighLevel, so fewer leads go cold.
- [AI phone receptionist](https://northlaneai.com/services/ai-receptionist/): An AI receptionist that answers when you can't, handles common questions and books the job. Not for sale until it passes our tests.

## Guides
- [AI visibility checklist for local businesses (2026)](https://northlaneai.com/guides/ai-visibility-checklist/): A 15-point checklist to get a small or local business found on Google and named by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.
- [SEO vs GEO vs AEO: what business owners need to know](https://northlaneai.com/guides/seo-vs-geo-vs-aeo/): Plain-English guide to SEO, GEO (generative engine optimization) and AEO (answer engine optimization) for small businesses, and what to do first.
- [How to get your business recommended by ChatGPT](https://northlaneai.com/guides/get-recommended-by-chatgpt/): Seven practical steps to get a small or local business named in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overview answers.
- [Google Business Profile checklist for local businesses (2026)](https://northlaneai.com/guides/google-business-profile-checklist/): A 16-point Google Business Profile checklist for local businesses: the basics, what you sell, proof, and the upkeep that keeps you showing in Maps and AI answers.
- [How to get more Google reviews without breaking the rules](https://northlaneai.com/guides/get-more-google-reviews/): A plain guide for local businesses on getting more Google reviews the allowed way: when to ask, what to send, how to reply, and what Google bans.
- [What a small-business website needs in 2026](https://northlaneai.com/guides/small-business-website-checklist/): What a small or local business website needs in 2026 to get calls and be found by Google and AI tools: clear pages, speed, proof, tracking and the basics machines read.
